ORDER BY
co.company_name DESC, p.person_id ps.code_name DESC, p.person_id p.access_end_dt DESC, p.person_id p.reg_dt DESC, p.person_id p.person_id DESC

p.person_id, p.person_name, p.birth_date, p.person_phone, p.company_code, p.title_code, p.person_type, p.status_code, p.main_task, p.affiliation, p.remark, p.biostar_user_id, p.id_check_file, p.security_edu_score, p.approve_file, CONVERT(varchar(10), p.id_check_dt, 23) AS id_check_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), p.security_edu_dt, 23) AS security_edu_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), p.final_approve_dt, 23) AS final_approve_dt, CONVERT(varchar(16), p.access_start_dt, 126) AS access_start_dt, CONVERT(varchar(16), p.access_end_dt, 126) AS access_end_dt, p.use_yn, p.del_yn, p.reg_dt, p.mod_dt, co.company_name AS company_name, ut.code_name AS title_name, ps.code_name AS status_name

FROM tb_person p LEFT JOIN tb_company co ON co.company_code = p.company_code LEFT JOIN tb_common ut ON ut.cmm_id = 'UT' AND ut.code_id = p.title_code LEFT JOIN tb_common ps ON ps.cmm_id = 'PS' AND ps.code_id = p.status_code
mapper.select:
SELECT
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT TOP 50 p.person_id, p.person_name, p.company_code, co.company_name FROM tb_person p LEFT JOIN tb_company co ON co.company_code = p.company_code WHERE p.del_yn = 'N' AND p.person_type = 'PT01' AND p.person_id LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' ORDER BY p.person_id

SELECT p.person_id, p.person_name, p.company_code, p.title_code, ut.code_name AS title_name FROM tb_person p LEFT JOIN tb_common ut ON ut.cmm_id = 'UT' AND ut.code_id = p.title_code WHERE p.del_yn = 'N' AND p.person_type = 'PT01' AND p.company_code = #{companyCode} ORDER BY p.person_id
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(person_id AS bigint)), 400000) + 1 AS varchar(20)) FROM tb_person WHERE person_type = 'PT01' AND person_id NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'
SELECT 'IS' + RIGHT('000000' + CAST( ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(person_id, 3, 10) AS int)), 0) + 1 AS varchar(10)), 6) FROM tb_person WHERE person_id LIKE 'IS[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_person (person_id, person_name, birth_date, person_phone, company_code, title_code, person_type, status_code, main_task, affiliation, access_start_dt, access_end_dt, remark, id_check_dt, id_check_file, security_edu_dt, security_edu_score, final_approve_dt, approve_file, use_yn) VALUES (#{personId}, #{personName}, #{birthDate}, #{personPhone}, #{companyCode}, #{titleCode}, #{personType}, #{statusCode}, #{mainTask}, #{affiliation}, #{accessStartDt}, #{accessEndDt}, #{remark}, #{idCheckDt}, #{idCheckFile}, #{securityEduDt}, #{securityEduScore}, #{finalApproveDt}, #{approveFile}, ISNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_person SET person_name = #{personName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, person_phone = #{personPhone}, company_code = #{companyCode}, title_code = #{titleCode}, status_code = #{statusCode}, main_task = #{mainTask}, affiliation = #{affiliation}, access_start_dt = #{accessStartDt}, access_end_dt = #{accessEndDt}, remark = #{remark}, id_check_dt = #{idCheckDt}, id_check_file = #{idCheckFile}, security_edu_dt = #{securityEduDt}, security_edu_score = #{securityEduScore}, final_approve_dt = #{finalApproveDt}, approve_file = #{approveFile}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId}
UPDATE tb_person SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE person_id = #{personId}
